name: Epokasite Runner
body:
EPOKASITE RUNNER
CR 8

XP 4,800
CN Medium fey
Init +4; Senses low-light vision; Perception +18
Aura draining (20 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +3 armor)
hp 97 (13d6+39)
Fort +7, Ref +12, Will +10
Defensive Abilities tech resistance 10
DR 5/cold iron; Resist electricity 10

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 flaming club +8/+2 (1d6+2 B plus 1d6 fire)
Ranged +1 flaming pistol +11/+6 (1d8+1/×4 B&P plus 1d6 fire, range incr. 20 ft., capacity 1, misfire 1, AP 3 CW)
Special Attacks anachronistic strikes (+1 flaming), regressing glare
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 8th, concentration +12)

At will—identify, incompetence (DC 14), shocking grasp
3/day—acid arrow, digital shield*, minor image (DC 16), make whole, manipulate tech
1/day—discharge (DC 17)

STATISTICS

Str 13 (+1); Dex 18 (+4); Con 16 (+3); Int 22 (+6); Wis 14 (+2); Cha 18 (+4)
Base Atk +6; CMB +7; CMD 22
Feats Amplified Glitch*, Dodge, Mobility, Rapid Reload (pistol), Run, Spring Attack, Toughness
Skills Acrobatics +20, Bluff +20, Diplomacy +20, Disable Device +17, Disguise +20, Intimidate +17, Knowledge (engineering) +19, Knowledge (history) +23, Knowledge (local) +22, Perception +18, Sleight of Hand +20, Stealth +20; Species Modifiers +4 Knowledge (history)
Languages Common, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Anachronistic Strikes (Su)

See above.

Draining Aura (Su)

See above.

Regressing Glare (Su)

As a standard action, an epokasite runner can focus their gaze on a technological or hybrid item within 30 feet. Unless it succeeds at a DC 18 Fortitude save, the item transforms into an anachronistic analogue of itself, such as a rifle turning into a musket or steamoperated crossbow. (If there is no appropriate analog, treat the item as if it has the broken condition.) This transformation lasts for 1d6+2 rounds, and any checks made to manipulate the item (such as operating a now-antiquated computer) take a –2 penalty. If the target is a weapon or armor that fails the save by 5 or more, it changes so dramatically that any user is treated as not proficient with the item. The epokasite runner can affect items of size Large or smaller with this ability, including computer terminals and vehicles. Once an item has saved against this ability, it’s immune to that runner’s regressing glare for 24 hours. An epokasite ignores all of a regressed item’s drawbacks listed above when using the item.

Tech Resistance (Su)

See above.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary or reenactment (2–4)
Treasure standard (masterwork studded leather armor, pistol, club, other treasure)
